Marissa — thanks for flagging. Procurement is open to a conditional no-PO path for time-boxed pilots under $10k, provided the following controls are in place: 

1) Completed PO Waiver form (procurement will upload to vendor record). See link: https://redwood-docs.internal/po-waiver-form
2) Pilot SOW with clear start/end dates and deliverables (we have the attached SOW, looks OK but add SOW ID)
3) AP routing: invoice must reference SOW ID and be sent to billings@redwood.com; finance needs vendor remit info and EIN on file (W-9 received).
4) SOC2 + basic security questionnaire completed and uploaded to vendor profile.
5) Single-invoice cap: $10,000 — any invoice above that requires standard PO process.
6) Approval chain: Procurement (Karthik) + Finance (Laura) must sign waiver. Legal escalation only if SOW contains unusual indemnities (not expected for pilot).

If sales collects the PO Waiver form and has the signed SOW, procurement will approve within 24 hours. Please confirm Marissa that BlueHelix will accept these guardrails.

Karthik Iyer
